name: early-return-alloc-leak
title: Early return leaks an allocation
fix_goal: Make heap ownership explicit even when validation or short-circuit logic wants to return early.
fix_steps: Find the p101_malloc-backed allocation in the scenario.
Find the return that exits while the pointer is still owned.
Move p101_free into a cleanup path that every return passes through.
Re-run ./lab.sh and confirm the early-return allocation lab is fixed.
lesson: An early return after allocation is a leak unless the return path releases the owned pointer.
